subject: Access controls: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist & service accounts — kickoff and config ask
messages:
From: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Harris <tharris@omnihealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Access controls: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist & service accounts — kickoff and config ask

Tom —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for your production rollout. Before we schedule the technical cutover, wanted to align on the access-controls scope so our CS and infra teams can prepare the deploy lane. Goal: enable SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning (users + groups), API/service accounts for server-to-server integrations, and add your office IP ranges to the allowlist.

Quick asks / agenda for this week:
- Can you share the SAML metadata XML (IdP) and certificate? (we attach our SP metadata on request)
- Public IP ranges we should allow for your traffic (CIDR list) — we have an ip-allowlist-template.csv attached you can fill.
- SCIM: do you expect user-only provisioning, or groups + nested groups? Any custom attributes (title, employeeType, costCenter)?
- Service accounts: will you need per-environment accounts (staging/prod) or a single account per integration?
- Org policies: any retention/GDPR constraints or restrict-by-region requirements we should preconfigure?

Next steps: if you can send the SAML metadata + filled IP CSV by EOD Wed (6/19), we’ll queue an infra ticket and propose a canary cutover window the week of 6/26. Internal owners: Monica (CS lead) will run the schedule, Ben (Platform eng) will own service-account provisioning and canary checks; Jordan (Security) will validate the IP allowlist and policy guardrails.

Attachments: ip-allowlist-template.csv (stub)

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0123

PS: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/hs-4821 — copying for visibility.

From: Tom Harris <tharris@omnihealth.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Access controls: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist & service accounts — kickoff and config ask

Aditya / Monica —

Thanks for the clear list. Attaching our current IdP metadata (omni_saml_metadata.xml). We are using Okta as our IdP and the metadata includes the cert; let me know if you need the raw cert separately.

IP ranges (public egress) — see below (also added to your CSV):
- 34.198.128.0/18
- 52.23.64.0/18
- 152.19.0.0/16

SCIM: we plan to provision users + groups. Groups will be used for role mapping (engineering, clinical, ops). No nested groups for now, but we do pass custom attribute employeeType and costCenter. Preferred provisioning cadence: near-real-time (provision on change).

Service accounts: we want distinct service accounts per environment (staging/prod). For prod, we need an account scoped to read-only telemetry + write for webhooks.

Org policies: Data residency requirement — some clinical records are EU-resident. For this customer, the initial rollout is US-only, but we may require EU geo-bound enforcement for later phases. Please confirm how Redwood surfaces org-level policies in the console.

Let us know if the above is sufficient or if you want a quick call.

Thanks —
Tom Harris
Director of Identity & Access | OmniHealth
tharris@omnihealth.com
Attachment: omni_saml_metadata.xml

From: monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Access controls: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist & service accounts — kickoff and config ask

Ben / Jordan — forwarding Tom's details. Action items I need from you so I can reply with a proposed schedule:
1) Ben: confirm service-account naming conventions and least-privilege role for the prod telemetry+webhook account. Also estimate how long to create dev/staging/prod accounts and add to RBAC.
2) Jordan: confirm whether the IP ranges Tom provided are sufficient for immediate allowlist and any extra checks we should run (ASN lookups / threat signal). Also advise on geo‑policy flagging — they mentioned EU residency possible later.

Quote from Tom: "SCIM: we plan to provision users + groups... we pass custom attribute employeeType and costCenter. Preferred provisioning cadence: near-real-time (provision on change)."

I propose we aim for a canary on 2028-06-27 and broad cutover 2028-06-30, assuming infra work is queued today. If either of you needs more time, flag now.

-Monica
Monica Patel | Customer Success Operations
monica@redwood.ai

From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Access controls: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist & service accounts — kickoff and config ask

Monica —

Notes / proposed config:
- Service accounts: create three scoped accounts: omni-staging-svc, omni-prod-svc-telemetry, omni-prod-svc-webhook. Prod telemetry: read-only tokens limited to metrics endpoints; webhook account only able to post to a single verified webhook endpoint. We will enforce short-lived keys (24h rotation) for webhook writes and issue a long-lived token only for internal automation.
- SCIM mapping: map Okta's "employeeType" -> custom attribute "employment_type", "costCenter" -> "org_cost_center". We'll support groups provisioning via group membership endpoint and will not sync nested groups by default. Attached is a proposed scim-schema.json for their review.
- IP allowlist: the three CIDRs look fine. I will run an ASN/geo check and flag private/CGN addresses if present.
- Rollout: agree on canary 6/27 with two-week monitoring. Need infra change ticket to open firewall rules and attach service-accounts to the tenant. I'll raise CS-3124 and link it here.

Attachments: scim-schema.json

-ben
Ben Carter | Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

From: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Harris <tharris@omnihealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Access controls: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist & service accounts — kickoff and config ask

Tom —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps and timeline:
- We received your IdP metadata (omni_saml_metadata.xml). Ben has proposed SCIM mapping and service-account names (see attached scim-schema.json).
- We will queue infra ticket CS-3124 today to apply the IP allowlist and provision the three service accounts.
- Proposed windows: canary on 2028-06-27 (1 hour window) -> monitor 48 hours; full rollout 2028-06-30.

Please confirm you are able to:
1) Populate the ip-allowlist-template.csv with any additional CIDRs by 6/19 EOD.
2) Confirm that Okta will send group membership changes in real-time (OIT) — otherwise we will schedule a short provisioning cadence.

Once you confirm, Monica will send calendar invites for the canary window and coordinate the rollback plan. If you'd prefer a short call to sign off, available tomorrow 10–11am PT.

Thanks for the collaboration — excited to get OmniHealth live.

Aditya Rao
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0123
Attachments: scim-schema.json, ip-allowlist-template.csv
